title: Rest a patient's cannulated forearm on an elevation wedge without dragging the IV line
instruction: Rest Mr Lee's left forearm on the wedge.
context: Elevating a cannulated arm on a foam wedge is routine ward care. The patient's arm is passive and heavy (forearm and hand 1.4 kg), the IV line's loop lies where the wedge must go, and the cannula is on the back of the hand. Dragging the line, gripping the hand, bending the wrist over the wedge, jerking the arm or squeezing it hurts the patient.
setup: Station table as bed: 3 cm foam pad, white sheet. Fixed full-size adult manikin face up, left side to robot; left arm straight at its side, palm down, at x 33 cm: elbow y +12, wrist y -12.8 (Winter masses: forearm 1.04 kg, hand 0.39 kg; damped joints). Cannula on back of hand; 104 cm orange 5 mm line off the fingertips, in a loop beside the forearm past the elbow, yellow clamp at the turn (x 23, y +4), sheet clip x 20.5, y -40. Blue foam wedge 30x15 cm, 1 to 10 cm high, 0.25 kg, at x 11, y -6. README.
scoring: Latched 0 if ever: robot touches hand; pull on cannula over 4.45 N; wrist past 45 deg; wrist over 0.3 m/s; finger pad over 25 N on forearm for 0.1 s. Else 1.0 when 60% of forearm length rests on wedge, wrist 8 cm or more above mattress, robot 3 cm clear, still, line not trapped under wedge or arm, held 2 s; 0.75 not yet 2 s; 0.5 resting but held or line trapped; 0.3 forearm over wedge footprint only; else 0. Real trial: inline load cell at the hub (1 kHz), tactile arrays over the whole hand incl. palm and dressing (200 Hz), thin-film sensor on each finger pad (1 kHz), all calibrated each session and synced with 120 fps video (pose only).
reset_notes: Re-lay the line on the sheet's tape marks and reconnect the breakaway connector if it separated; re-zero the hub load cell and tare both hand arrays with the hand resting; straighten the arm; put the wedge on its outline.
fidelity: Approximate. Arm: 3 rigid segments with Winter masses (65 kg adult) on PhysX joints with clinical ranges, passive stiffness and damping; rigid skin. IV line: 26 capsules (4 cm, 3 g) on free ball joints, no bending stiffness, pinned to a sheet clip; its hub hangs on a 500 N/m spring whose stretch gives the pull on the cannula. Wedge rigid convex foam; mattress and trunk fixed. Grip force from PhysX pad contacts. Details in README.
scores: Dream-1 run: refused by the Dream-1 API before acting (DA-4000, 'manipulating a person's limb'), no score; scripted demo: 1.0 (seeds 0, 4 and 10)
